content.text: Section 28 matches our preferred position exactly, and no arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document.

input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and a waiver of venue/forum objections. This is precisely the playbook preferred position (New York law; exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in New York County). A document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no mandatory or offshore arbitration seat to remediate. The carve-out in 28.2 permitting either Party to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere is mutual and customary, and the 28.3 executive-escalation step expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so neither undermines the approved forum. No redline required.
